modules.title: oidcc-discovery-endpoint-verification: the discovery document is served as JSON and has the metadata the specifications require
modules.name: oidcc-discovery-endpoint-verification

modules.title: oidcc-idtoken-rs256: an id_token requested with RS256 is signed with RS256 and names its key
modules.name: oidcc-idtoken-rs256

modules.title: oidcc-idtoken-unsigned: an id_token requested with alg none is returned unsigned, or the test is skipped when the OP does not support none
modules.name: oidcc-idtoken-unsigned

modules.title: oidcc-userinfo-rs256: the userinfo response is a JWT signed with RS256 when the client registered for it
modules.name: oidcc-userinfo-rs256

modules.title: oidcc-ensure-redirect-uri-in-authorization-request: a request without redirect_uri is answered with an error page, not a redirect
modules.name: oidcc-ensure-redirect-uri-in-authorization-request

modules.title: oidcc-redirect-uri-query-OK: a redirect_uri with the registered query component completes the authorization
modules.name: oidcc-redirect-uri-query-OK

modules.title: oidcc-redirect-uri-query-mismatch: a redirect_uri whose query differs from the registered one is rejected with an error page
modules.name: oidcc-redirect-uri-query-mismatch

modules.title: oidcc-redirect-uri-query-added: a redirect_uri with a query when none is registered is rejected with an error page
modules.name: oidcc-redirect-uri-query-added

modules.title: oidcc-redirect-uri-regfrag: a registration with a redirect_uri containing a fragment is rejected
modules.name: oidcc-redirect-uri-regfrag

modules.title: oidcc-discovery-endpoint-verification: the discovery document is served as JSON and has the metadata the specifications require
modules.name: oidcc-discovery-endpoint-verification

modules.title: oidcc-server: the code flow returns a valid code, tokens and id_token, and the access token works at userinfo
modules.name: oidcc-server

modules.title: oidcc-registration-logo-uri: a client registered with a logo_uri gets a login page showing the logo
modules.name: oidcc-registration-logo-uri

modules.title: oidcc-registration-policy-uri: a client registered with a policy_uri gets a login page linking to the policy
modules.name: oidcc-registration-policy-uri

modules.title: oidcc-registration-tos-uri: a client registered with a tos_uri gets a login page linking to the terms of service
modules.name: oidcc-registration-tos-uri

modules.title: oidcc-registration-jwks-uri: a client registered with a jwks_uri authenticates with keys the OP fetches from it
modules.name: oidcc-registration-jwks-uri

modules.title: oidcc-registration-sector-uri: a registration with a sector_identifier_uri listing the redirect_uri is accepted
modules.name: oidcc-registration-sector-uri

modules.title: oidcc-registration-sector-bad: a registration whose sector_identifier_uri does not list the redirect_uri is rejected
modules.name: oidcc-registration-sector-bad

modules.title: oidcc-server-rotate-keys: the OP's jwks_uri has a new signing key after a rotation and still has the old one
modules.name: oidcc-server-rotate-keys

modules.title: oidcc-refresh-token-rp-key-rotation: a refresh token is accepted with a client assertion signed by a rotated RP key
modules.name: oidcc-refresh-token-rp-key-rotation

modules.title: oidcc-request-uri-unsigned: an authorization request passing an unsigned request object by reference completes
modules.name: oidcc-request-uri-unsigned

modules.title: oidcc-request-uri-signed-rs256: an authorization request passing an RS256 signed request object by reference completes
modules.name: oidcc-request-uri-signed-rs256

modules.title: oidcc-ensure-request-object-with-redirect-uri: the redirect_uri in the request object takes precedence over an invalid redirect_uri parameter
modules.name: oidcc-ensure-request-object-with-redirect-uri

modules.title: oidcc-refresh-token: refresh tokens are issued to and usable by their client only, and refresh the tokens
modules.name: oidcc-refresh-token

modules.title: oidcc-ensure-client-assertion-with-iss-aud-succeeds: a client assertion with the issuer as audience is accepted at the token endpoint, or rejected with invalid_client
modules.name: oidcc-ensure-client-assertion-with-iss-aud-succeeds

modules.title: oidcc-client-test: the RP logs in with the code flow and calls the userinfo endpoint
modules.name: oidcc-client-test

modules.title: oidcc-client-test-invalid-iss: the RP rejects an id_token whose iss is not the issuer
modules.name: oidcc-client-test-invalid-iss

modules.title: oidcc-client-test-missing-sub: the RP rejects an id_token without sub
modules.name: oidcc-client-test-missing-sub

modules.title: oidcc-client-test-invalid-aud: the RP rejects an id_token whose aud is not its client_id
modules.name: oidcc-client-test-invalid-aud

modules.title: oidcc-client-test-missing-iat: the RP rejects an id_token without iat
modules.name: oidcc-client-test-missing-iat

modules.title: oidcc-client-test-kid-absent-single-jwks: the RP verifies an id_token without kid with the only matching key
modules.name: oidcc-client-test-kid-absent-single-jwks

modules.title: oidcc-client-test-kid-absent-multiple-jwks: the RP rejects an id_token without kid or finds the key among several
modules.name: oidcc-client-test-kid-absent-multiple-jwks

modules.title: oidcc-client-test-idtoken-sig-rs256: the RP accepts an id_token signed with RS256
modules.name: oidcc-client-test-idtoken-sig-rs256

modules.title: oidcc-client-test-idtoken-sig-none: the RP accepts an unsigned id_token from the token endpoint, or stops
modules.name: oidcc-client-test-idtoken-sig-none

modules.title: oidcc-client-test-invalid-sig-rs256: the RP rejects an id_token with an invalid RS256 signature
modules.name: oidcc-client-test-invalid-sig-rs256

modules.title: oidcc-client-test-userinfo-invalid-sub: the RP gets a userinfo response whose sub is not the id_token's (it must reject it)
modules.name: oidcc-client-test-userinfo-invalid-sub

modules.title: oidcc-client-test-nonce-invalid: the RP rejects an id_token whose nonce is not the one it sent
modules.name: oidcc-client-test-nonce-invalid

modules.title: oidcc-client-test-scope-userinfo-claims: the RP requests claims with the profile, email, phone or address scope
modules.name: oidcc-client-test-scope-userinfo-claims

modules.name: oidcc-client-test-client-secret-basic
